newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romanian November industrial output rises 4.9 pct.
newsitem.headline: Romanian November industrial output rises 4.9 pct.

text.p: Romanian industrial output rose 4.9 percent in November, reversing the previous month's slide, National Statistics Board (CNS) data showed.
ROMANIAN INDUSTRIAL OUTPUT NOV 96 OCT 96 NOV 95
NOTE: Figures adjusted for number of working days.
The CNS said industrial production was 7.4 trillion lei in November, while January-November output stood at 62.8 trillion lei, or 9.1 percent up from the year-ago period.
Some 19 percent of January-November output went to exports, down from about 20 percent in the same period of 1995.
Hourly productivity fell 1.8 percent in November from October but rose 12.6 percent year-on-year.
Industry employed 2.213 million people at end-November, 6,300 fewer than in October.
